listing.name: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault Breakthrough (OpenMoHAA)
listing.summary: Use the official OpenMoHAA Windows player for Breakthrough with your own matching PC data. Keep original files and the external save profile backed up.
listing.original_game_title: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault Breakthrough

steps.title: Prepare the matching PC game
steps.instruction: Before Play, prepare your own complete Breakthrough PC data and its Allied Assault base game. Upstream recommends GOG Warchest; CD copies need the matching language patches (Allied Assault 1.11 and Breakthrough 2.40b). Keep the originals unchanged in a separate installation. Copy only the original PK3 files and sound/video resources into main, maintt beside the official player. Preserve the matching folder names and all required original resources; do not copy old executables, DLLs or unrelated expansion files over this runtime. Portcove does not verify original-game identity. Console editions and demos are different products. Keep the complete official Windows x64 package and its own DLLs together, including openmohaa.exe and launch_openmohaa_breakthrough.exe. Follow upstream Visual C++ x64 runtime prerequisites when needed.

steps.title: Keep an existing prepared copy
steps.instruction: Use a private working copy of the original game folder. Extract the complete official openmohaa-v0.82.1-windows-x64.zip into it, preserving DLLs and companions. Follow upstream Visual C++ x64 runtime prerequisites when needed. Register launch_openmohaa_breakthrough.exe with the game root as working directory. This title-specific launcher selects Breakthrough and waits for openmohaa.exe to exit. Do not select omohaaded.exe, PDB archives or another expansion launcher. This remains a non-owning external registration. You and upstream own runtime replacement and every file; removing its registration preserves them. A catalog update does not migrate or adopt that copy.
